capabilities: Drag and drop any block via a left-edge handle
Control indent level by horizontal drag position
Select and drag multiple blocks as a group
Convert or delete block types from a context menu
Customize handle icon, size, color, and offset
extras: The plugin publishes a platform-agnostic npm core package for reuse in other editor platforms.
problem: Rearranging blocks in Obsidian requires cutting and pasting or using limited drag ranges; native drag-and-drop is not block-level like Notion's.
summary: Drag-and-drop editor enhancement that lets users grab any block (paragraphs, headings, lists, tables, callouts) via a handle to rearrange content.
